fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NVDA) FY2027 Q3 revenue more than doubled with gross margin expanding from 73.4% to 74.8%, but stock fell 33% from year-start.
fields.summary_ko.1: Wall Street average target price implies 63% upside over 12–18 months, with highest target at 363% and lowest at $130 (-13% from current), reflecting ongoing turmoil after Jensen Huang's CEO resignation.
fields.summary_ko.2: Vera Rubin chipset demand remains strong and FY2028 sales growth guidance raised from 70% to 75%, but China export controls and management vacancy pose key risks.
